stories.headline: Spot bitcoin ETFs erase October's early gains after two heavy outflow days
stories.blurb: US spot bitcoin ETFs lost about $485M on Oct 7 and $244M on Oct 8 — the heaviest two-day stretch since June — turning October net negative. Friday's print looked near-flat (partial). — This week's BTC slide was driven by institutional redemptions, not leverage; demand has to stabilize before the old $83–87k range can be reclaimed.

stories.headline: BTC holds the $80k area and settles near $82.5k into the weekend
stories.blurb: After breaking the post-Sept-21 ~$83k floor midweek and probing ~$80.3k Thursday, bitcoin recovered toward ~$82.5k as oil fears eased and Trump ruled out Iran strikes before the midterms. — Holding ~$80k kept the monthly uptrend intact; reclaiming ~$83k is the near-term tell, while failing $80k would open a deeper drawdown.

stories.headline: Macro calendar: September CPI on Oct 14, then the Oct 27–28 FOMC
stories.blurb: Markets head into next week watching Wednesday's inflation print and the late-October Fed meeting, after September's hike and hawkish minutes helped reset rate expectations. — A hot CPI could revive hike bets and keep pressure on risk assets; a cooler print would ease the liquidity headwind that weighed on ETF demand this week.

stories.headline: Futures leverage keeps washing out as open interest falls with price
stories.blurb: CheckOnChain still shows a Deleveraging Sell-Off: seven-day futures OI down about 2.7% alongside a ~2.3% price drop, with funding mild and positive. — Leverage is being cleared rather than added — less fuel for forced selling than a leveraged washout, but also less dry powder for a fast squeeze.

stories.headline: Thailand green-lights spot BTC and ETH ETFs for exchange listing from Oct 16
stories.blurb: Thailand's SEC issued rules allowing spot bitcoin and ether ETFs to list on the Stock Exchange of Thailand from October 16, with local custodians and no margin trading. — Another regulated on-ramp in Asia, but it is a medium-term access story — not a near-term offset to this week's US ETF outflows.
